examples.title: Worker'ni ohista to'xtatish
Osilib qolgan ishni qayta navbatga qo'yish
examples.code:
type Job = { id: number; state: "waiting" | "active"; lockUntil?: number }
let now = 0
const jobs: Job[] = [{ id: 1, state: "waiting" }, { id: 2, state: "waiting" }]
const LOCK = 30_000
const take = () => { const j = jobs.find(j => j.state === "waiting"); if (j) { j.state = "active"; j.lockUntil = now + LOCK } return j }
const checkStalled = () => jobs.filter(j => j.state === "active" && j.lockUntil! < now).map(j => { j.state = "waiting"; return j.id })

take(); take()
console.log("0 s: ikkala ish active (worker 2-ishda qulab tushdi)")
now = 10_000; jobs.splice(0, 1); console.log("10 s: #1 tugadi va o'chirildi")
now = 45_000; console.log("45 s: qayta navbatga qo'yildi:", checkStalled())
console.log("holat:", jobs)

10 s: #1 tugadi va o'chirildi

blocks.text: **Serializatsiya** — obyektni javob sifatida yuborishdan oldin uni tayyorlash: parolni olib tashlash, sanani formatlash, hisoblangan maydon qo'shish. NestJS buni `ClassSerializerInterceptor` va `class-transformer` dekoratorlari bilan qiladi.

examples.code:
const LEVELS = { verbose: 0, debug: 1, log: 2, warn: 3, error: 4, fatal: 5 } as const
type L = keyof typeof LEVELS
const makeLogger = (min: L) => (level: L, msg: string) => { if (LEVELS[level] >= LEVELS[min]) console.log(`${level.toUpperCase().padEnd(7)} ${msg}`) }

const log = makeLogger("warn")
log("debug", "SQL: select * from users")
log("log", "so'rov bajarildi")
log("warn", "javob 1.2 s davom etdi")
log("error", "timeout")

const mask = (text: string) => text
    .replace(/\+?998[\s-]?\d{2}[\s-]?\d{3}[\s-]?\d{2}[\s-]?\d{2}/g, m => { const d = m.replace(/\D/g, ""); return `+998 ${d.slice(3, 5)} *** ** ${d.slice(-2)}` })
    .replace(/([\w.])[\w.]*@([\w-]+\.)+\w+/g, (m, first) => `${first}***@${m.split("@")[1]}`)
